requirements.text: Fill apps/api/.env from .env.example: MongoDB Atlas, the HubSpot deal webhook, the Learning Portal keys, Gemini, BigQuery, AWS SES, NxtDial, Google sign-in, and your own email in BOOTSTRAPADMINEMAILS.
Open and sign in with Google.

The NxtDial server has three additions in the screeningtool repo (deploy with fly deploy): the batch /results endpoint, API keys may use /api/rating-templates (needed only for one agent per job), and a spoken goodbye when the time limit ends a call.
